purpose: D2 pre-registration revision 2: review round 24 fixes (five P2). Revision-1 record preserved byte-identical alongside; that record remains the v1 evidence.
reasons: P2-1 isolation checker treated missing corpus sources as success; verdict now fails on any missing source (verdict_for + selftest).
P2-2 order concordance compared frozensets against a tuple set and never read actual positions (always agreed); now compares ACTUAL within-group positions of both labelers; reversal probe pins it.

P2-3 freeze entry accepted zeroed registered hashes and did not bind identity files; freeze now verifies registered hashes against working tree AND committed blob, validates identity files bound through the protocol, and records both in the freeze record; .gitattributes pins registered files (-text) and tools (eol=lf) so clean checkouts keep identical bytes.
P2-4 metric tool crashed (KeyError) on legal JSON plans lacking coreference; shape guard now reports structural problems that feed the failure/retry flow (probes T10/T11).

P2-5 prompt draft had undefined inputs: R3 leading-time self-reference resolved to the first fact WITH an entityId (semantically identical to the frozen annotation interpretation); itemId substitution and the 16-item selected-fact rule (frozen target filter, selected_of-compatible) written down; revision log added. Rubric and annotation evidence unchanged.

Round 25: P2-3 residual closed - the freeze entry verified the REGISTERED paths but consumed args.items unbound; consumed --items bytes must now equal the registered items hash, labels files must match the protocol annotator labels names (same-name and renamed substitution rejection probes added).

history.note: review-24 rewrite; superseded by round-27 gold-side validation, strict coreference entry shape and diagnostic16 mode
consumed-file binding; superseded by round-27 protocol/tool pinning, bind_consumed pure function and frozen-path assertions

isolationTool.note: added to the registration; v1 did not pin it

operationalisation: G2 antecedent denominator = comparable groups; pronoun-site denominator = all gold sites
H1/H2 judge raw plans; structural problems void item G-metrics and fail gates

annotationEvidenceUnchanged.note: rubric, protocol registered hashes, dual-AI labels, identities and the frozen gold are byte-identical to f27af30; the frozen gold file hash is restated in the regenerated freeze record.

semanticChanges: coreference entries with fields beyond {mention, refersTo} were previously only punished through the G2 exact-entry comparison; they are now a STRUCTURAL violation (H1/H2 fail, the attempt enters the retry flow, the item fails after the retry).
a gold row missing a factId previously crashed the scorers with KeyError; gold rows are now validated like plan rows and a broken gold voids the item with a reported problem.

the 16-item v2 set is demoted to diagnostic-only: its H1 denominator was the FULL fact set while the arm consumes the target-selected subset (a correct selected-coverage plan scored h1 0/16), and it has no organisation gold so G1-G4 are undefined; diagnostic16 mode scores H1/H2 over target-intersected facts with gate=false and never pass=true. The 8-item gate is unchanged. Ruling: coordinator decision, recorded by the C reviewer as not a technical endorsement.
